arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, memorable hooks; dark and moody vibes throughout; emphasis on heavy hooks and minimal verses to highlight energy dynamics.

event_markers.label: Strong Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Mark beginning of high-energy hook section

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Mark beginning of final hook with elevated energy

track_roles.drums: rhythmic backbone, support sparse verses and highlight hooks
track_roles.bass: provide low-end groove complementing drums, sparse in verses
track_roles.chords: dark harmonic backdrop with minimal complexity
track_roles.vocal: primary storytelling element with intense hook delivery
track_roles.fx: atmospheric enhancements especially in hooks and transitions

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns that are sparse during verses and punchy on hooks emphasizing trap-style hi-hats and sharp snares.

bass_generator.brief: Create deep, minimal bass lines that complement the drums and support the dark mood, especially active during hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce dark harmonic textures with sparse chord activity throughout verses and richer voicings during hooks.

melody_generator.brief: Design simple but effective melodic motifs that enhance hooks without overcrowding verses.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow ensuring energy curve matches sparse verses and strong hook contrasts.

presetor.brief: Apply settings to maintain clarity in sparse verses and fullness on hooks, preserving dark and moody tonal balance.

songgps.brief: Guide arrangement positioning of sections and dynamic energy peaks aligned with Memphis Rap style and mainstream variation.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix guidelines that highlight vocal presence and hook dynamics while maintaining space for sparse verses.
